answer: Identity here is a refundable stake plus a reputation score only independent peers can raise. A stranger may wander in freely, but votes weigh nothing until attested. To fabricate a bloc, an attacker must lock funds across thousands of wallets and hold them through an unbonding delay, so each fake sybil costs real capital and time. Clusters trading only with themselves get slashed, so the cost curve turns quadratic while honest actors pay near zero. Reputation binds to attestations, not keys: a fresh key is an island, not a platform, and a rogue zephyr of borrowed votes cannot sway a vote.
